footnote_text: On October 16, 2026, Investments AKA, LLC ("AKA") and the Issuer entered into an amendment to the Issuer's Convertible Promissory Note CN-1, originally issued to AKA on July 28, 2026 (the "Note"). Pursuant to the amendment, the entire outstanding principal balance of $1,000,000 was immediately exchanged for 200,000 shares of Common Stock and warrants to purchase 200,000 shares of Common Stock, based on the price and warrant coverage applicable to the offering discussed in footnote 4. The Note was canceled upon the exchange. Any accrued and unpaid interest was waived and forgiven and was excluded from the exchange consideration. || Before the amendment, the Note's conversion price depended on the price of a future qualifying financing and was not fixed. Accordingly, the Note was not previously reported as a derivative security pursuant to Rule 16a-1(c)(6). The amendment established the consideration and security quantities reported herein, and the acquisitions are reported as of its effective date. || These shares are held directly by Investments AKA, LLC which is managed by Agassi Ventures, LLC which is managed by Andre K. Agassi. All of the membership interests of Investments AKA, LLC are held by Agassi Ventures, LLC. The Andre Agassi Trust, of which Andre K. Agassi is the Trustee, holds all of the membership interests of Agassi Ventures, LLC.
